summary.text: Xue San Si, called Sky Tiger, is a strength path Gu Master challenged by little beast king at San Cha Mountain.

claims.text: After killing Fei Li on San Cha Mountain, Fang Yuan asks the watching crowd where Sky Tiger Xue San Si is and tells them to say that both of them are strength path Gu Masters and that in three days he will visit her to exchange pointers. Talk treats the challenge as further ferocity after Tyrant Heng Mei and Fei Li.
Spectators say that although she looks ordinary, she has the proper curves, a great body, and is indeed a beauty. Her arms are slim.

On her first move her slim arms burst out in bright light and turn into two tiger claws. On the second her body expands over twice her original size; the hair on her body becomes longer as brownish-yellow tiger fur, her eyes become tiger eyes, her teeth grow into fangs, and a symbol appears on her forehead, with a winged Biao phantom behind her. On the third a large pair of brownish-yellow wings grows from her back; she climbs about one kilometer, then dives as a Biao image overlaps her body until she seems a true Sky Tiger.

When she first hears the challenge she refuses to believe it, noting she has no relationship with the black and white demons and has never met them, then confirms it and classifies Fang Yuan as a lunatic, wondering why he challenges with the three kings inheritance opening in a few days. She has rank four middle stage cultivation and judges her strength about the same as Tyrant Heng Mei and Fei Li. She thinks he is stepping on seniors to build reputation, and recalls that when she was young she did similar acts but only against rank three Gu Masters. She does not want the fight, but her godfather is in closed cultivation refining a Gu, and refusing would wreck the reputation she built over many years in the demonic path, so she accepts. They set a wide valley as the battle site.

Three days later Fang Yuan meets her and addresses her as Sky Tiger. She is shocked that he looks gentlemanly, with dark, peaceful eyes rather than a fierce face. He recounts that she offended a higher-up in her clan and was exiled, secretly worked hard, took risks to kill beast kings and arm herself with their Gu, then returned and killed the elders who framed her. Spectators say that although she looks ordinary, she has the proper curves, a great body, and is indeed a beauty. Fang Yuan proposes he stand still for three of her hits, then answer with one; she agrees, attracted by the terms.

On the first move her arms become tiger claws and she knocks him flying. On the second her body expands over twice, brownish-yellow tiger fur and fangs appear, and a winged Biao phantom forms behind her. Biao is a flying tiger, the king among the tigers; its strength is five times a tiger’s, and its beast phantom can suppress three to four of Fang Yuan’s ordinary beast phantoms. She decides to use all her strength to finish him in three hits. For the third move brownish-yellow wings grow from her back and she climbs about one kilometer before diving, overlapping a Biao image with her body until she seems a true Sky Tiger; activating two Biao phantoms in a row costs her a huge price as her strongest attack.

As she dives, Fang Yuan runs instead of standing still, she crashes into the ground, and beast phantoms finish her; pieces of her corpse litter the crater. Spectators shout that Sky Tiger is dead and that little beast king broke his agreement. Fang Yuan later thinks she was bound by reputation in accepting the challenge, and that the agreement was meant to restrain her flying Gu, which would otherwise have let her escape upward where he could not reach her. No demonic Gu Master stands out for her afterward, and righteous path Gu Masters who want to move cannot easily do so without looking like they are taking revenge for a demonic figure.

Li Xian treats the killing of Sky Tiger, after a broken promise, as the point when little beast king became a thorny problem. Talk names her godfather Century Boy as a rank four upper stage Gu Master who will most likely find trouble when the inheritance opens.
Fang Yuan had been interested in her Biao strength Gu, but turning her into minced meat also destroyed the Gu on her body. Century Boy is named as her patron.

Yi Huo later warns Fang Yuan that Sky Tiger Xue San Si was Century Boy’s goddaughter, and that Century Boy has been watching him: a wood path Gu Master at rank four upper stage and a thorny character of the demonic path.
